title: Macroeconomics Minimodel (MACROEC)
description: Assets and income of an economy, first on an unlimited energy source and then, after CONT, on a renewable one.

program.caption: The BASIC listing MACROEC, as printed: 57 numbered lines for the IBM PC, plotting income Y and assets K with PSET.

diagram.caption: The minimodel in energy systems symbols: an energy source E drives production from assets K and consumption C; production feeds assets, income is split into savings S and consumption, and assets depreciate to a heat sink.

notes: The scan's typeface does not distinguish the letter O from the digit zero. T0, Y0 and K0 are read as zeros: TO is a reserved word, and each name is assigned before it is used. 'rewnable' in line 452 is Odum's. The listing ends its first run at line 450 END; the second run, with renewable resources, is reached by typing CONT, as line 3 says, and the site's Continue button and `odum run --cont 1` do the same. Both runs draw on one screen, since line 480 returns to line 100 and skips the CLS in line 4, which is why Figure 3 shows them together.
